headlines.title: Deadly Bangkok pub blaze revives concerns over fire safety lapses
headlines.snippet: Al Jazeera's Tony Cheng reported from the scene of a deadly fire that ripped through a popular pub in Bangkok. The blaze occurred around midnight on Monday.

headlines.title: Oil prices jump as US and Iran trade attacks over Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Brent crude oil prices increased by over 4 percent. This rise is attributed to clashes between Washington and Tehran over the control of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Israel releases video of hidden tunnels below Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle
headlines.snippet: The Israeli Army released footage of what it claims are hidden tunnels beneath Lebanon's historic Beaufort Castle. The army stated these tunnels were discovered under the castle.

headlines.title: At least 27 dead as fire engulfs popular Bangkok pub near Chatuchak market
headlines.snippet: A fire that rapidly spread through a popular pub in Bangkok killed at least 27 people and injured 63 others. Many of the injured are in critical condition.

headlines.title: Japan’s pet care industry booms as ‘fur babies’ outnumber infants
headlines.snippet: Japan's baby product manufacturers are shifting their focus to the pet market. This change is happening amidst a declining birthrate in the country, with pets increasingly referred to as 'fur babies'.

headlines.title: Kuwaiti army says it is confronting 'hostile aerial targets'
headlines.snippet: The Kuwaiti army reported confronting "hostile aerial targets" within its airspace. Earlier, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed responsibility for targeting US military bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Jordan.

headlines.title: Iran claims strikes on US bases in Jordan, Bahrain and Kuwait
headlines.snippet: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Corp Guards (IRGC) stated they targeted US military bases in Jordan and Bahrain. The IRGC claimed their attack on Prince Hassan Air Base in Jordan caused fires in fuel and ammunition depots, and also reported strikes in Bahrain and Kuwait.

headlines.title: Centcom says new wave of strikes on Iran completed
headlines.snippet: US Central Command (Centcom) announced the completion of its latest wave of attacks against Iran. They reported hitting numerous targets, including air-defense systems, radar sites, and missile and drone capabilities. Centcom emphasized that Iran does not control the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: US bases in Jordan, Bahrain reportedly targeted
headlines.snippet: US bases in Jordan and Bahrain were reportedly targeted, with explosions heard in both countries. Flight-tracking services indicated flight suspensions in Jordan following the attacks.

headlines.title: Sirens blare in Bahrain
headlines.snippet: Air raid sirens sounded in Bahrain, prompting the interior ministry to advise residents to "remain calm and head to the nearest safe place."

headlines.title: Sudan court sentences RSF leader to death in absentia
headlines.snippet: A court in Sudan has sentenced the leader of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) to death in absentia. The verdict was issued by Al Arabiya English.

headlines.title: Kuwait says three border posts, offshore oil platform attacked
headlines.snippet: Kuwait reported that three border posts and an offshore oil platform were attacked. The reports came from Al Arabiya English.

headlines.title: Trump Recalls Last Conversation With Sen. Graham

headlines.snippet: Israel claims it destroyed Hezbollah tunnels located in Lebanon. The report was provided by Al Arabiya English.

headlines.title: Syria’s Parliament Holds First Session After Assad’s Fall
headlines.snippet: Syria's Parliament convened its first session following the fall of Assad. This event was reported by Al Arabiya English.

headlines.title: Israel to hold parliamentary election on October 27
headlines.snippet: Israel is scheduled to hold a national election on October 27. This will be the first election since the "genocidal war on Gaza."

headlines.title: US strikes Iran as Gulf states targeted in flareup over Hormuz
headlines.snippet: The US launched a new series of strikes on Iran, which retaliated with attacks on Gulf countries. Oil prices saw an increase amidst these escalating events.

headlines.snippet: In Syria's new parliament, 22 out of 210 members are women. These female representatives come from diverse ethnic, religious, and ideological backgrounds.

headlines.title: Eight people including girl killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
